test_title: PYST 10: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option figure that will replace question mark (?) in the following figure series. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08e06dc6d53d0963fce5d548027d2b2a81670fe34ccc2d50866ee91aa3ea214d.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:​

__
 
• The straight line is rotated 90⁰ in anticlockwise direction from figure to figure.
 
• Arrow moves 45⁰ in anti-clockwise in each step at the same position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26404657f21a71df1fd99849273b7aa615bf84ce529842ae23101f5f0a352079.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f37d1e3b8fb08720c20e78d1f394fb9acb56d95f78f1f086237393c0411691f2.png] 

**Observe Options carefully**__** :**

Option 1) :

 
• Here arrow is rotated 135⁰ clockwise direction.
 
• Straight is above the circle and arrow.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8797213577cf552df869b4dd7f3cc7baf20a8d40178aa591e4788a22b541b753.png] 

Option 2) :

 
• Here arrow is rotated 45⁰ anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Straight line is beside arrow.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e36d95cef2dd4ef8756b3d456ea102a4c551167e91402184ef825d64ae6158c1.png] 

Option 3) :

 
• Here arrow is rotated 45⁰ clockwise direction.
 
• Straight line is above the circle and arrow.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a896b322388adcc14b2d6490cd5e53cae93ca3a05d590e54d4943f26a822fed.png] 

Option 4) :

 
• **Here arrow is rotated 45⁰ anti-clockwise direction.**
 
• **Straight line is above the circle and arrow.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45e7769e4ca378022173a68c26c876d077c5f1a8fccdeacae90b178e446adc3f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
